dimensions.assessment: Affects regional populations and entities involved in the San Joaquin River restoration and Friant Division.
Provides substantial additional funding for water and environmental restoration projects.
Authorizes increasing appropriations to $750,000,000 for settlement implementation and $75,000,000 for Friant Division improvements.
Amends existing authorization amounts in previous public laws.
Long-term funding authorizations for ongoing regional restoration efforts.
